Title: Uni-Mol molecular representation
Description: Uni-Mol encodes a molecule into 512 features while reasoning explicitly in three dimensions, taking atomic coordinates as input rather than a flat graph. Zhou and colleagues pretrained the transformer on a large collection of conformations together with protein pockets, adding a position-recovery objective so the network learns geometry rather than memorising conformers. Because the representation depends on 3D structure, results vary with the conformer supplied, and individual dimensions have no chemical reading.
Interpretation: 512 features encoding molecular structure from a 3D-aware pretrained transformer.
